evidence_recent.title: Employee or Independent Contractor Status Under the Fair Labor Standards Act, Family and Medical Leave Act, and Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act
evidence_recent.summary: This final rule rescinds the analysis for determining employee or independent contractor status under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA or Act) set forth in the Department of Labor's (Department) regulations and replaces it with an analysis similar to what it published in a final rule promulgated in 2021, with several modifications and enhancements. In addition, this final rule amends provisions in the Department's regulations implementing the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA) to provide that employee or independent contractor status under those laws should be determined using the Department's FLSA analysis, as the FMLA and MSPA both incorporate the FLSA's scope of employment.

Executive Compensation Disclosure Reform
evidence_recent.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission ("Commission") is proposing amendments to its executive and director compensation disclosure rules to make the requirements more principles-based and to reduce compliance burdens for registrants, while maintaining the disclosure of material information to investors. The proposed amendments would focus the disclosures on the principal executive officer ("PEO") and principal financial officer ("PFO"), streamline the tabular disclosure requirements, and simplify and rationalize various other aspects of the compensation disclosure rules, including the Compensation Discussion and Analysis ("CD&A"), pay ratio, pay- versus-performance, and perquisites disclosure requirements.

evidence_recent.title: Prohibiting Illegal Discrimination in Registered Apprenticeship Programs
evidence_recent.summary: The Department of Labor (DOL or the Department) is issuing this final rule to remove the onerous and legally questionable affirmative action requirements that were previously imposed by the Department on Registered Apprenticeship program sponsors. This final rule also streamlines and simplifies nondiscrimination obligations for all program sponsors, while clarifying that sponsors are accountable for compliance with Federal and State nondiscrimination protections. evidence_recent.title: Medical Devices; Hematology and Pathology Devices; Classification of the Digital Cervical Cytology Slide Imaging System With Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
evidence_recent.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is classifying the digital cervical cytology slide imaging system with artificial intelligence algorithm into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in this order and will be part of the codified language for classification of the digital cervical cytology slide imaging system with artificial intelligence algorithm. We are taking this action because we have determined that classifying the device into class II will provide a reasonable assurance of the safety and effectiveness of the device. We believe this action will also enhance patients' access to beneficial innovative devices, in part by reducing regulatory burdens.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller
evidence_recent.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-123890: Broadcom VMware vCenter
evidence_recent.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

evidence_recent.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-76466: Cisco Expressway Series
evidence_recent.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
evidence_recent.summary: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-40217: BerriAI LiteLLM
evidence_recent.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
evidence_recent.summary: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis
evidence_recent.summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-115731: Perforce Puppet Enterprise
evidence_recent.summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

evidence_recent.summary: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-123039: Check Point Multiple Products
evidence_recent.summary: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-124194: Microsoft Office

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-20320: Cisco BroadWorks

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-111560: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products
evidence_recent.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

evidence_recent.title: CVE-2026-116606: Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
evidence_recent.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

changes.event: A (fictional) state appellate court held a retailer liable for refund promises
changes.event_description: A state appellate court (the item marks it as fictional, a manually entered demo) held a retailer liable for refund promises its customer-service chatbot made. The court rejected the defense that the chatbot was a separate agent responsible for its own statements, and it let affected customers pursue their claims together as a group.
changes.reasoning: This is directly on point for unauthorized_commitment. Liability for chatbot promises is already reflected in the prior through the Moffatt v. Air Canada reference, so the new element is that group claims were allowed. A systematic chatbot promise made to many customers can now aggregate into a group claim. That points to a higher share of claims becoming group claims, so I propose a +30% change to tail.prob. A possible secondary effect is a higher p_claim_given_harm, but only one parameter can be moved and the group-claim holding is the more novel signal. An appellate ruling would normally rate as strong. I rated it moderate because the item is labeled fictional or demo, comes from a single jurisdiction, and gives no loss figures.

changes.event: Code to Deploy Destructive AI Agent Discovered in Amazon Q VS Code Extension
changes.event_description: Malicious code inserted into an official Amazon Q VS Code extension release instructed the AI agent to wipe local and cloud resources. The release was later revoked.
changes.reasoning: This is a real provider-level compromise that shipped to many users at once, which is a precursor of a systemic event. No widespread losses were reported, so it supports only a slight upward nudge.

changes.event: Data Destruction via Indirect Prompt Injection Targeting Claude Computer-Use
changes.event_description: HiddenLayer researchers hid a prompt injection in a PDF. When Claude Computer Use opened the file, it ran a shell command that wiped the filesystem.
changes.reasoning: A research demonstration with no real victim. It shows that agentic tool access lets a successful injection cause destructive loss, which supports a small upward nudge to the share of injections that cause harm.

changes.event: Data Exfiltration from Slack AI via Indirect Prompt Injection
changes.event_description: PromptArmor showed that a malicious post in a public Slack channel could make Slack AI leak private data, such as an API key, to an attacker.
changes.reasoning: A demonstration with no reported loss. It shows a realistic exfiltration path through retrieval-based assistants, so at most a weak signal.

changes.event: Financial Transaction Hijacking with M365 Copilot as an Insider
changes.event_description: Zenity researchers sent a crafted email that made Microsoft 365 Copilot give a user the attacker's bank details for a wire transfer.
changes.reasoning: A red-team exercise with no actual fraud loss. It is consistent with injection leading to financial fraud, so a weak upward signal.
